name: Isasicursor
sum: An elasmarian ornithopod from the Late Cretaceous Chorrillo Formation of Santa Cruz, Argentina, found with the titanosaur Nullotitan.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: MPM 21525, from the upper Chorrillo Formation (Maastrichtian), Estancia La Anita, Santa Cruz Province.
material: Paratypes from the same site, including a partial cervical vertebra (MPM 21526) and dorsal vertebrae (MPM 21527).
biology: Contemporary of the titanosaur Nullotitan; habits not described in the sources consulted.
author: Novas et al. 2019
